The '''Armageddon teleport scroll''' is an item that can be purchased from the [[Deadman Reward Store]] for 9,000 [[Deadman: Apocalypse/Points|Deadman Points]], which is earned from participating in [[Deadman: Armageddon]]. It can be used to unlock a Deadman: Armageddon-themed [[Home Teleport]] [[animation override]]. To enable it, players can right click "Animation" on the Home Teleport spell icon in their spellbook and select "Armageddon."

[[File:Annihilation weapon scroll detail.png|130px|left]]
The '''Annihilation weapon scroll''' can be used to cosmetically change the [[toxic staff of the dead]], [[Bow of Faerdhinen (c)]], or all three pieces of [[Crystal equipment#Crystal armour|crystal armour]]. It can be purchased from the [[Deadman Reward Store]] for 12,000 [[Deadman: Apocalypse/Points|Deadman Points]], which are earned from participating in seasonal [[Deadman]] events.

The scroll can be used by bringing it to [[Nigel]]. When you give the scroll to [[Nigel]], it will permanently unlock the 5 cosmetics for the player and remove the scroll permanently. You can then freely switch any of the items{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Goblin|url=https://np.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/1qkr9lh/deadman_annihilation_everything_you_need_to_know/o18lh98/|title=Deadman: Annihilation - Everything You Need to Know|quote=12k points, permanent unlock that you can use on all affected items, so one scroll can do all armour pieces + bow!|date=23 January 2026|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/apzmT|archivedate=2026-01-31}} between their standard and deadman variant at [[Nigel]], and it can be applied to however many of the item you wish.

Crystal equipment reverted from the Deadman variant will be reset to the default colours of the item; the [[Crystal equipment#Recolouring|Meilyr clan colours]] for the armour, and the [[Bow of Faerdhinen (c)|Hefin clan colours]] for the bow.

Upon PvP death the PK'er will receive the normal variant of the item.<ref>OldSchoolRS; Let's Talk Deadman: Armageddon! stream. https://www.youtube.com/live/enmaX1RmXLw?t=1670s</ref>

[[File:Annihilation blueprints detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Annihilation blueprints''' can be used to change a [[player-owned house]]'s appearance to the [[Wilderness (theme)|Wilderness theme]] [[house style]]. Having the [[Estate agent]] re-decorate your house into the Wilderness house style while having the blueprints in the inventory will consume them and permanently unlock the house style.

Upon unlocking the house style, a set of [[Annihilation exit portal blueprints]] will replace the consumed Annihilation blueprints in the player's inventory, which can then be used to recolour the exit portal. These exit portal blueprints can be infinitely reclaimed from [[Nigel]] in [[Lumbridge]].

==Setting up an orange exit portal==
Due to how [[exit portal]]s work in player-owned houses, additional steps are required to replace the normal purple exit portal with the orange Wilderness-themed one. 

* Build a new [[Garden]] room in your POH. This will not be permanent.
* In the new garden, build a basic [[exit portal]].
* Remove the original exit portal and build an Annihilation exit portal (using the [[Annihilation exit portal blueprints]]) in its place.
* Remove the second garden, if you wish.

[[File:Deadman's skull detail.png|130px|left]]
The '''Deadman's skull''' is an item in [[Deadman: Annihilation]] that players can interact with to purchase sigils and quest lamps from the [[Deadman: Annihilation/Skull shop|skull shop]]. Duplicate sigils can be sold back to the skull shop by using them on the deadman's skull while in your inventory. [[Archaic emblem]]s can also be exchanged for points by using them on the skull.

If lost, it can be reclaimed from the [[Emblem Trader]] at the [[Grand Exchange]].

==Features==
===Unlocks===
The "Unlocks" right-click option opens an interface showing all [[Deadman: Annihilation/Skull shop|sigils]] available, showing which have or have not been purchased. Toggleable sigils (such as the [[Sigil of Remote Storage]]) can be turned on and off by clicking them.

===Swap===
The "Swap" right-click option allows for swapping between different [[spellbook]]s and [[prayer]] books. A spellbook can only be swapped to if the prerequisites have been fulfilled (e.g. completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]] to use the [[lunar spellbook]]). To swap to the [[Ruinous Powers]] prayer book, a player must buy the [[Ruinous powers (Deadman Mode)|Ruinous Powers tome]] from the skull shop.

Swapping prayers can be done anywhere and while in combat. However, swapping spellbooks can only be done within a [[safezone]] and out of combat.

===Breach check===
The "Breach Check" right-click option displays the time to the next [[breach]].
